name: meticulate
description: Meticulate helps sales and go-to-market teams research companies directly in Codex.

interface.longDescription: Meticulate helps sales and go-to-market teams research companies directly in Codex. Upload a company list or describe the accounts you care about, then identify companies, find similar targets, pull key business details, and answer structured research questions across accounts.
defaultPrompt: Conduct research on this list of companies.
Find competitors to Snowflake and compare their firmographics.
Search for companies matching this market description.
